thread:
Aditi Rao: taking the late shift now, primary for the next 8h. TL;DR: embeddings pipeline in eu-west is seeing queue growth + transient 5xx for some customers. I’m passing the bridge to Jon (secondary) and CCing Mira for morning overlap. See mitigations in-flight below.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered at 21:07 UTC for alert 'emb-queue-depth > 1000' (severity=P1) — tickets/INC-5782 created.

Aditi Rao: What we know so far:
- Timeline: spike started ~20:55 UTC after a batch prefetch job overlapped with higher customer inference traffic.
- Symptoms: embeddings queue depth climbed from ~120 -> ~2200 in ~6min; p99 latency up to 5.2s for affected routes; ~3% 5xx errors observed on embeddings service for some customers.
- Suspected cause: prefetch/backfill job combined with suboptimal batching leading to KV cache thrashing.

Samir Patel: did a quick rollback of the prefetch job at 21:11, confirmed job stopped. Pre-rollback logs show many small requests hitting the same model shard.

Jon Park: I created a temporary routing rule to move non-critical traffic to dedicated-emb-pool-2 at 21:15. That reduced load on primary pool by ~45% within 4m.

Aditi Rao: Active mitigations (do not revert unless stable for 30m):
1) Rate-shed low-priority prefetch and background jobs (implemented).
2) Route non-SLA customer embeddings to dedicated-emb-pool-2 (Jon).
3) Bumped autoscale max for embeddings-worker to 30 replicas in eu-west (Samir).
4) Enabled sticky-KV-cache hold for hot keys for 15m to reduce cache misses.

Commands used (for on-call reference):
```
# scale replicas
kubectl -n production scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=30
# add routing override (example)
redwoodctl routes create --name temp-emb-route --selector "tier!=sla-critical" --target dedicated-emb-pool-2 --ttl 30m
```

Mira Chen: Observability notes:
- Dashboards: emb-queue, emb-processor-errors, emb-runtime-p99. Link: https://console/redwood/dashboards/embeddings (bookmark).
- Logs: check /services/embeddings/processor logs around 20:50-21:20, look for repeated KV cache miss patterns.
- Customer-facing metrics: use /customers/impact endpoint to pull list; I pulled prelim list: AcmeCorp, BrightApps, Tutorly (IDs: cust-243, cust-992, cust-118). Might be partial.

Aditi Rao: Customer impact: degraded throughput and increased latency for non-routed customers; small fraction of calls returned 5xx. No full outages reported, but customers on high-throughput pipelines may see errors. I opened interim status note for affected customers.

Jon Park: Current status as of 21:35 UTC: queue depth stabilized ~260 -> trending down, p95 back to ~900ms, p99 ~1.8s. Error rate down to 0.6%. Continuing to monitor.

Aditi Rao: Runbook pointers / escalation:
- Primary runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/embeddings-queue-surge
- If we see sustained queue depth > 1000 for 15m after mitigations, escalate to infra-sre (pager) and consider full secondary-pool swap (follow section 'pool-swap-procedure').
- If KV eviction errors increase > 2% trigger immediate cache flush plan (see runbook).

Samir Patel: Note on rollback risk: re-enabling prefetch without addressing batch sizing will re-spike the queue. Any change to prefetch needs approval from oncall+infra.

Aditi Rao: Coverage & ownership:
- Primary (night): Aditi Rao (me).
- Secondary (on-call backup): Jon Park (reachable via @jon / pager).
- Morning overlap: Mira Chen (will join 06:30 UTC for handover).
- OpsBridge: will page infra-sre if we trigger full escalation.

Aditi Rao: Coverage gaps / TODOs for next shift:
- Confirm customer notifications are sent to affected accounts (I drafted a status message, need someone from SRE/SE to post in customer Slack channel).
- Validate that dedicated-emb-pool-2 has correct model versions and quantization profiles — Jon to verify.
- Run extended load test in staging to validate batching change (Mira / infra to schedule).

Jon Park: Verified pool models at 21:28 — same model v1.2.3, quantization matches, no version skew. Will re-check at 22:00 before I drop to standby.

Aditi Rao: If you pick up this thread and are taking over, please ack with ETA and confirm you’ve reviewed the runbook steps above. If you are stepping off early, handover must include confirmation that queues are decreasing and error rate < 0.5% for 20m.

Mira Chen: I’ll pick up at 06:30 UTC. My ETA to be primary at handover is 06:35. Will confirm everything stable and post final notes.

Aditi Rao: Thanks — leaving monitoring pinned on the bridge. I’ll stay reachable for the next 30m for any quick follow-ups. :thumbsup:

OpsBridge: Bridge closed by Aditi at 21:51 UTC (note: mitigations in place).
